entries.name: Alabama vehicle tag (registration) renewal - County license offices / ADOR Motor Vehicle Division
entries.parent_company: Alabama Department of Revenue
entries.service_area_detail: Statewide; renewals handled by the 67 county licensing offices
entries.notes: Alabama tags are renewed through the county license commissioner/probate judge/tax collector, not the state. The ADOR Vehicle Licensing Offices page lists each county office and which counties offer online renewal (county portals vary, e.g. altags.com / renewyourtag.com / county sites). Online renewal needs the PIN from the renewal notice or the driver license number. Renewal is annual in the owner's staggered month; ad valorem (property) tax is due with the tag. ADOR MyDMV portal: https://mydmv.revenue.alabama.gov/TAP/ (plates/personalized tags). ADOR FAQ: not all Alabama counties mail registration renewal notices; failure to receive one does not excuse late renewal - check with the county licensing official (county offices listed on the Vehicle Licensing Offices page). Email/text reminders, where offered, are run by the county (e.g., through county online renewal portals).

entries.name: Arizona MVD vehicle registration renewal (AZ MVD Now)
entries.parent_company: Arizona Department of Transportation - Motor Vehicle Division
entries.mail_payment_address: Arizona Department of Transportation, Motor Vehicle Division, PO Box 29008, Phoenix, AZ 85038
entries.senior_programs: Arizona Vehicle License Tax exemptions: 100% VA-disabled veterans drawing compensation (and surviving spouses until remarriage), veterans who bought the vehicle with a VA grant, SSI disability recipients, and people with a county widow/widower, total-and-permanent-disability or disabled-veteran property tax exemption.
entries.notes: Quick Registration Renewal on AZ MVD Now needs no login; account at https://azmvdnow.gov/ shows vehicle records. Also renew at MVD/Authorized Third Party offices, by mail, or cash at CheckFreePay retail locations. Most vehicles can be registered for 1, 2 or 5 years depending on emissions requirements. MVD sends notice by mail or email ~45 days before expiration. Registration fee includes Vehicle License Tax (VLT) based on vehicle value.

entries.name: 91 Express Lanes (OCTA/RCTC)
entries.parent_company: Orange County Transportation Authority / Riverside County Transportation Commission
entries.mail_payment_address: 91 Express Lanes, P.O. Box 68039, Anaheim, CA 92817 (include account number)
entries.payment_processor: PayNearMe (cash replenishment/violation payments at 7-Eleven, CVS, Walgreens, Walmart; $1.99 fee)
entries.senior_programs: Disabled Veteran and Special Recognition license plates (CA DMV; Gold Star Family excluded) ride free with a Special Access Account and FasTrak transponder; Disabled Person plates get a Special Access Account (no monthly fee).
entries.notes: FasTrak accounts for the SR-91 express lanes. RCTC (15 Express Lanes) contact: https://www.rctc.org/contact-us/ (951-787-7141). FAQ and Contact pages: card/bank on file auto-charged when balance needs replenishment; one-time payments online or by check; close account by signing in > Manage Account > Request Account Closure; statements and low-balance notices are emailed. Walk-in: 301 Corporate Terrace Circle, Corona, CA 92879; OCTA Store, 600 S. Main St, Orange, CA 92868. Account Agreement page documents auto-replenish amounts ($30 or one month's average usage when balance < $25). Account agreement: statements arrive by mail or e-notification; charges not disputed within 30 days are deemed accepted. FAQ: card/bank is charged automatically when the prepaid balance needs replenishment; close account via My Account > Manage Account > Request Account Closure. No toll-by-plate: unpaid trips get a Notice of Toll Evasion Violation (Violation Ordinance page).

entries.name: Bay Area FasTrak (bridges and express lanes) and toll invoices
entries.parent_company: Bay Area Toll Authority (Metropolitan Transportation Commission)
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: 877-BAY-TOLL (877-229-8655) for invoices and account payments; Bay Area Toll Payment Plan 844-419-8714
entries.payment_processor: Conduent (FasTrak customer service site runs on Conduent-hosted services, per page source)
entries.senior_programs: Payment assistance: one-time courtesy penalty waiver, low-income penalty waivers (income limits listed) and the Bay Area Toll Payment Plan for balances of $100+.
entries.notes: Pay a toll invoice or violation online; open a license plate account (https://www.bayareafastrak.org/en/routers/videoaccount.html). Covers Golden Gate Bridge tolls too (https://www.goldengate.org/bridge/tolls-payment/). FasTrak accounts use automatic replenishment. Payment & Account Replenishment FAQ: card auto-charged when balance < $15 (or threshold) for the greater of one month's average use or $25. Manage Your FasTrak Account FAQ: close account online via Account Settings and Payment Methods > Close Account (or by form/phone); monthly or quarterly statements by email free, by mail for a fee. Toll invoice ladder (Invoices and Penalties FAQ): initial toll invoice is toll only if paid within 21 days; first violation notice adds $5 per crossing, second notice $15 (reduced to $25 total if paid within 15 days of the second notice). Low-income penalty waiver for household income up to 200% FPL; Bay Area Toll Payment Plan spreads $100+ balances over up to 2 years (bayareatollpaymentplan.org). Statements by email are free (Manage Your Account FAQ).

entries.name: California DMV vehicle registration renewal
entries.parent_company: California Department of Motor Vehicles
entries.mail_payment_address: DMV Renewal, PO Box 942897, Sacramento, CA 94269-0001
entries.notes: Renew online, by phone, by mail, at DMV offices, or at DMV Now kiosks (cash accepted at select kiosks: https://cadmvnowkiosk.com/). Smog certification may be required first. Fees include registration fee, vehicle license fee (VLF) and county/district fees; use the fee calculator. Also renew at AAA (members) and business partners. Paperless Notices page: in a MyDMV account choose Communication Preferences to get vehicle registration renewal notices (and DL/ID renewals) by email with a direct link to online renewal. Registration Fees page: the billing (renewal) notice arrives about 60 days before expiration - if it does not, contact DMV or use the Fee Calculator.

entries.phone_customer_service: 1-877-229-8655 (toll payment inquiries incl. FasTrak); outside US +1-415-486-8655
entries.payment_processor: Bay Area FasTrak (BATA regional customer service center)
entries.notes: Billed via Bay Area FasTrak. All-electronic tolling: FasTrak, License Plate Account, One-Time Payment (https://www.goldengate.org/bridge/tolls-payment/one-time-payment/), toll invoice, or cash at retail (https://www.goldengate.org/bridge/tolls-payment/toll-payment-options/paying-with-cash/). Toll Assistance Programs page describes the BATA/Golden Gate policy (from July 1, 2023) for lower-income residents and waivers of penalties on late/missed payments. Golden Gate Bridge FasTrak accounts are Bay Area FasTrak accounts; autopay/close/statements per the Bay Area FasTrak FAQs. Golden Gate invoices are toll-only (no fees) when paid on time; first California invoice is mailed about one week after crossing. Cash-based FasTrak accounts need a $30 minimum prepaid balance; the toll-lane display reads 'Low Balance' when it is time to replenish. Statements, payment plans and penalty waivers are handled by Bay Area FasTrak.

entries.name: Metro ExpressLanes (LA County I-10 / I-110 / I-105)
entries.parent_company: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority
entries.mail_payment_address: Metro ExpressLanes, PO Box 39110, Los Angeles, CA 90039 (do not send cash)
entries.payment_processor: PayNearMe (cash)
entries.senior_programs: Low-Income Assistance Plan: qualifying LA County residents get a one-time $25 credit toward FasTrak deposits and waiver of the $1 monthly account fee.
entries.notes: Replenishment and violation notices can be paid in cash at 7-Eleven via PayNearMe ($1.99 fee). Account Options page: Automatic Replenishment account - $40 initial prepayment, $0 transponder deposit, auto-replenishes (min $40) when balance reaches $10. Account Options: automatic replenishment, $40 initial prepayment and $40 minimum replenishment. Pay As You Go: trips without FasTrak get a Notice of Toll Evasion Violation mailed to the registered owner (toll plus a $9 processing fee). Cash account replenishment and violation payments at participating 7-Eleven stores ($1.99 fee, PayNearMe).

entries.parent_company: RCTC 15 Express Lanes (Riverside County Transportation Commission)
entries.notes: FasTrak express lanes on I-15; RCTC 951-787-7141.

entries.name: San Diego FasTrak (SR-125 South Bay Expressway, I-15 Express Lanes)
entries.parent_company: San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG)
entries.payment_processor: ETAN Tolling (FASTLane back-office system, per page metadata)
entries.senior_programs: SANDAG Veterans Toll Exemption Program: vehicles with qualifying California veteran license plates (e.g., Disabled Veteran) registered on a SANDAG FasTrak account get a 100% toll discount on SR 125 and I-15 Express Lanes (applied within 24 hours).
entries.notes: SANDAG FasTrak account and toll payments. SANDAG FasTrak page: manage account and pay tolls/violations online; customer service 888.889.1515, customerservice@sandag.org; walk-in SANDAG Customer Service Center, 1129 La Media Road, San Diego, CA 92154 (Mon-Fri 8-6, cash accepted). myfastrak.511sd.com is a JavaScript account app. SANDAG Customer Service Center (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm) takes toll, Pay-By-Plate and violation payments. Pay-By-Plate and violation payments are on the myfastrak.511sd.com portal. ETAN Tolling (FASTLane back-office system, per page metadata).

entries.name: The Toll Roads (Orange County FasTrak - SR 73, 133, 241, 261)
entries.parent_company: Transportation Corridor Agencies
entries.payment_processor: PayNearMe (cash toll payments at retail locations)
entries.notes: Pay tolls within 5 days after driving without an account; resolve violations https://secure.thetollroads.com/violation/login; ways to pay https://www.thetollroads.com/driving-the-toll-roads/planning-ahead/ways-to-pay-tolls; pay online within 5 days of the trip. Managing-my-account FAQ covers updating payment info, prepaid account replenishment and closing an account. Statements FAQ: statements emailed monthly; online, sign in > 'Statements & Activity' > Running Balance or Standard Statement. Its 'pay toll' button goes to secure.thetollroads.com/tolls/pay-toll  and violations to secure.thetollroads.com/violation/login; cash via PayNearMe. Account statements are emailed monthly; view them under Statements & Activity after logging in. Drivers without an account can pay tolls online within the posted window (Ways to Pay Tolls); otherwise a Notice of Toll Evasion is mailed. Violation payment plans and disputes have their own FAQ pages. Cash payments and account replenishment at Customer Service Centers or PayNearMe retailers.

entries.name: Colorado vehicle registration renewal (myDMV / county motor vehicle offices)
entries.parent_company: Colorado Department of Revenue - Division of Motor Vehicles
entries.service_area_detail: Statewide; processed by county motor vehicle offices
entries.notes: Colorado registrations are processed by county motor vehicle offices; online renewal through Colorado myDMV (state portal), by mail to your county, in person, or at self-service kiosks. Specific ownership tax is included and declines with vehicle age.

entries.name: ExpressToll (Colorado Express Lanes and E-470)
entries.parent_company: E-470 Public Highway Authority (operates ExpressToll for CDOT and Northwest Parkway)
entries.mail_payment_address: E-470 / ExpressToll, P.O. Box 5470, Denver, CO 80217-5470
entries.notes: E-470 and CDOT express lanes: ExpressToll transponder accounts or License Plate Toll invoices (higher rate). Violations: https://e470.com/toll-rates/violations/. Account closure is by mailed note or by calling the Service Center. E-470 warns it is not affiliated with third-party toll payment processors. ExpressToll User Agreement (JavaScript page; content confirmed via search index): monthly statements free by email and online in the ExpressToll account; mailed statements may carry a monthly fee. E-470 License Plate Toll: a statement is mailed to the DMV-registered owner; a License Plate Toll online account lets drivers pay before a statement, get monthly statements by email, and let E-470 charge a stored card automatically when each monthly statement is due. Unpaid tolls go to violation and, after a final order, a Colorado registration hold. Toll transaction disputes use an online form linked from the Violations page; hearing-officer appeals go through Colorado courts.

entries.name: Connecticut DMV vehicle registration renewal
entries.parent_company: Connecticut Department of Motor Vehicles
entries.mail_payment_address: Department of Motor Vehicles, P.O. Box 150456, Hartford, CT 06115-0456
entries.notes: Renew online (individuals), by mail, or in person (appointment). Invitation to renew arrives by mail or email 45 days before expiration. Emissions test compliance required; late emissions fees apply. Registrations are generally 3 years (2 for some). CT DMV military registration page explains the registration fee waiver for qualifying military personnel.

entries.name: DC DMV vehicle registration renewal
entries.parent_company: District of Columbia Department of Motor Vehicles
entries.notes: Vehicle registration renewal is online through DC DMV online services, by mail or in person; fees are weight-based and vary. Ticket Alert Service (TAS) emails/texts registration expiration reminders and ticket notices. DC parking/photo tickets must be paid before renewal. The Registration and Ticket Alert Service (TAS) sends renewal and ticket alerts by email/text. The Excise Tax Exemptions List page has a PDF of the amended exemption categories.

entries.name: Delaware DMV vehicle registration renewal (myDMV)
entries.parent_company: Delaware Division of Motor Vehicles
entries.notes: Renew online in myDMV (My Vehicles > Renew Your Registration) when no inspection is due; no added online fee. Otherwise renew at a DMV lane with inspection. Online services index: https://dmv.de.gov/OnlineServices/index.shtml. Vehicle Registration eNotification sign-up available. DE DMV emails or sends automated phone renewal notices 90, 60 and 30 days before expiration to owners with an email/phone on file; sign up on the eNotification page (links.paperless). Renew up to 90 days early.

entries.notes: Make a payment and view statements after login (same page). FAQ: itemized statement monthly for the first month, then quarterly, delivered by e-mail. Violations page links Pay or Appeal (acct.ezpassde.com/Violations.aspx). Walk-in E-ZPass Service Center: 22-24 W. Loockerman Street, Dover, DE 19904. Online ACH payments were temporarily suspended at check time (card only).

entries.name: E-PASS (Central Florida Expressway Authority) and CFX Pay By Plate
entries.parent_company: Central Florida Expressway Authority
entries.notes: Pay CFX toll invoices (Pay By Plate) online; E-PASS prepaid accounts. E-PASS discount program: transponders with 40+ monthly transactions get automatic toll savings credited on the 15th. Auto-replenishment is set up in the online account with a debit or credit card. Pay By Plate invoices can be paid by phone, online, E-PASS app, in person, or with cash plus $1.50 fee at retail. FAQ: monthly statement by email with toll detail per vehicle; printed statements cost $0.50 each. Reload E-PASS page adds funds; auto-replenishment by card is set in the online account. Pay By Plate invoices are mailed to the registered owner, due in 30 days, at double the E-PASS rate; unpaid invoices become Uniform Traffic Citations (also payable at the Pay Your Invoice page). Volume discounts up to 25% for frequent E-PASS users.

entries.name: SunPass (Florida's Turnpike Enterprise) and Toll-By-Plate invoices
entries.parent_company: Florida Department of Transportation - Florida's Turnpike Enterprise
entries.service_area_detail: Statewide Florida (FDOT/Turnpike, Tampa Hillsborough Expressway, GMX Miami-Dade, and others accept/billed via SunPass)
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: 1-888-865-5352 (1-888-TOLL-FLA; add funds or pay invoices by phone)
entries.payment_processor: Conduent (SunPass Centralized Customer Service System vendor per public reporting; not shown on pages fetched this session); cash reloads via Blackstone retail network
entries.notes: Pay a Toll Enforcement Invoice / Toll-By-Plate invoice via invoice inquiry (also linked from Tampa Expressway and GMX). Other pages: contact https://www.sunpass.com/en/support/contactus.shtml; add funds/Easy Pay https://www.sunpass.com/en/about/easypay.shtml; cash replenishment https://www.sunpass.com/en/about/cash.shtml; collections notices https://www.sunpass.com/en/unpaid/collection.shtml; registration stop (tax collector) payments. Florida's Turnpike toll-by-plate info: https://floridasturnpike.com/tolls/toll-by-plate/. Unpaid tolls can place a hold on FL vehicle registration. SunPass User Manual: Easy Pay = automatic replenishment from saved card/bank when balance is low; cash replenishment at authorized retailers (Blackstone locator); account activity viewable online free, mailed monthly statements for a fee; call center Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, Sat 8:30am-5pm. To close a SunPass account: sign in > Account Profile > Close My Account. SunPass User Manual: Easy Pay links a card or bank account and automatically adds a preset amount when the balance gets low ($10 minimum balance to activate); manage or turn it off in the online account or by phone. Activity is viewable online free; mailed monthly statements cost a fee (no separate e-statement page; online account is the paperless option). Toll-By-Plate: Toll Enforcement Invoice to the first registered owner with a $2.50 administrative charge per invoice.

entries.name: Tampa Hillsborough Expressway Authority (Selmon Expressway) Toll-By-Plate
entries.parent_company: Tampa Hillsborough Expressway Authority
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-888-865-5352 (Toll-By-Plate/SunPass payments); collections 1-877-258-5205; registration hold line 1-877-754-1431; THEA admin 813-272-6740 (no customer toll records)
entries.notes: Invoices are paid through SunPass invoice inquiry; Toll-By-Plate invoices for the Selmon Expressway are billed through SunPass/Florida's Turnpike. A SunPass customer can still get an invoice if the card used for automatic replenishment expires. Prepaid accounts for this facility are SunPass accounts (Florida's Turnpike Enterprise); autopay (Easy Pay), closing and statements follow the SunPass User Manual  and FAQ. Toll-By-Plate invoices are paid via sunpass.com invoice inquiry or 1-888-865-5352. Toll-by-Plate FAQ: invoices cover image capture, owner lookup and mailing; SunPass users pay 25 cents less per toll and no administrative fee. Registration holds for tolls in collections are paid to THEA's collection agency, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP). Statements, Easy Pay auto-replenishment and account closure are handled by SunPass.

entries.name: Georgia vehicle tag renewal (DRIVES e-Services / county tag offices)
entries.parent_company: Georgia Department of Revenue - Motor Vehicle Division
entries.service_area_detail: Statewide; administered by 159 county tag offices
entries.senior_programs: Georgia: free disabled veteran's license plate for qualifying Georgia-resident disabled veterans (surviving unremarried spouse also eligible); several military/veteran specialty plates carry no registration or annual fees; form MV-30 gives qualifying veterans relief from state and local TAVT.
entries.notes: Renew online via DRIVES e-Services (participating counties), at self-serve kiosks, by mail or at the County Tag Office. Renew up to 90 days before your birthday-based due date; late: $5 registration penalty + 10% of ad valorem tax. 'Go Green' in DRIVES e-Services to get renewal notices by email. Payment by card or e-check with convenience fees. Paperless: in DRIVES e-Services select Go Green to get renewal notices by email instead of mail.

entries.name: Peach Pass (Georgia Express Lanes) and toll violations
entries.parent_company: State Road and Tollway Authority (SRTA)
entries.mail_payment_address: Peach Pass Customer Service Center, State Road and Tollway Authority, P.O. Box 92386, Atlanta, GA 30314 (in-state violations); SRTA, PO Box 2644, Atlanta, GA 30301-2644 (out-of-state violations)
entries.payment_processor: Final demand letters/collections paid via PAM (dspayments.com/GSRIK); Peach Pass accounts with SRTA
entries.notes: Pay violation notices online; $25 administrative fee per violation, civil penalties up to $70 if escalated to OSAH. Monthly statements or a custom statement are available in the account on mypeachpass.com (annual statements not currently offered). Autopay setup/cancel and statements are all covered on the FAQ page; account management is on mypeachpass.com or the Peach Pass GO! app. Final Demand letters are payable to SRTA, PO Box 1212, Horseheads, NY 14845-1200. SRTA (srta.ga.gov) operates Peach Pass and the Georgia Express Lanes. FAQ: accounts need an active credit/debit card for automatic replenishment (more than one replenishment per month possible); close via mypeachpass.com or Peach Pass GO! app > My Account > Request Account Closure (transponder deactivated at once, account stays open 15 business days; $5 fee for paper refund checks). Georgia has no toll-by-plate billing: trips without a valid pass become toll violations (pay or dispute online). Cash option: BancPass Pay n Go reload card ($20 starter kit, $2 reload fee).

entries.name: Guam Department of Revenue and Taxation - Motor Vehicle Division (vehicle registration)
entries.parent_company: Government of Guam
entries.service_area_detail: Vehicle registration renewals, driver's licenses and Guam IDs.
entries.payment_processor: MyGuamTax online vehicle registration renewal (Visa, MasterCard, Discover, AmEx; tiered convenience fee $2.45-$4.45 or 2.75% over $150)
entries.notes: Myid.guam.gov is the driver's-license/Guam ID renewal and appointment portal, not vehicle registration. Vehicle registration is renewed online in MyGuamTax: needs a MyGuamTax account, a registration expiring within one month, insurance and a passed safety inspection (valid 3 months) reported electronically by a participating insurer and inspection station; you print the renewed registration and the tag is mailed in 7-10 business days. Renewals more than one month (up to three) early, new vehicles, military (SSCRA) and government vehicles must be done in person at the MVD office. Guide PDF: https://www.myguamtax.com/help/VehicleRegRenewalGuide.pdf. MVD page lists branch phones and a Vehicle Registration Transfer-on-Death beneficiary FAQ. Driver's-license appointments: http://realid.guam.gov/SelfRegistration and http://myid.guam.gov.

entries.name: Hawaii motor vehicle registration renewal - City & County of Honolulu
entries.parent_company: City and County of Honolulu - Department of Customer Services
entries.mail_payment_address: P.O. Box 30330, Honolulu, HI 96820-0330
entries.senior_programs: Starting July 1, 2026, veterans 65+ (not dishonorably discharged) are exempt from the $20 City and County registration fee for one vehicle annually. City & County of Honolulu Veterans Benefit (from July 1, 2026): U.S. veterans 65+ not dishonorably discharged are exempt from the $20 county motor vehicle registration fee on one non-commercial vehicle per year (exemption form CS-L on the page; other state/city taxes still apply).
entries.notes: Hawaii registrations are county-run. Honolulu: renew online (2.35% card fee), at DMV kiosks in select Safeway/Foodland stores (2.5% + $4), satellite city halls, or by mail (check). Fee calculator: https://mvinquiry.hnl.info/. Email MVINFO@honolulu.gov.

entries.name: Hawaii motor vehicle registration renewal - Hawaii, Maui and Kauai Counties (ehawaii.gov)
entries.parent_company: County of Hawaii / County of Maui / County of Kauai (via Hawaii Information Consortium)
entries.payment_processor: Tyler Technologies (eHawaii.gov / Tyler Hawaii runs the online renewal portal)
entries.notes: Neighbor-island counties use the state ehawaii.gov renewal portal: Hawaii County https://mvr.ehawaii.gov/renewals/hawaii/lookup, Maui https://mvr.ehawaii.gov/renewals/maui/lookup, Kauai https://mvr.ehawaii.gov/renewals/kauai/lookup. Requires plate number and last 4 of VIN, renewal within 45 days of expiration, current safety inspection and unchanged mailing address. Maui info: https://www.mauicounty.gov/1549/Registration-Renewal. Kauai DMV phone reported as 808-241-4256.

entries.name: Iowa vehicle registration renewal (county treasurers / iowatreasurers.org)
entries.parent_company: Iowa State County Treasurers Association / Iowa DOT
entries.mail_payment_address: Renew by mail to your county treasurer (address on renewal notice)
entries.payment_processor: ReNewGov (designs and maintains the Iowa county treasurers' online renewal site iowatreasurers.org)
entries.senior_programs: Iowa Disabled Veteran (DV) plate: seriously disabled veterans who received VA financial assistance (38 U.S.C. 3901-3904) to buy the vehicle get the DV plate and exemption from annual registration fees for that vehicle.
entries.notes: Renew in your county of residence online at iowatreasurers.org (PIN from renewal notice), by mail, or in person at the county treasurer. Autos 1-7 years old: 40 cents per 100 lb + 1% of list price (e.g., $197 for a 3,000 lb/$18,500 car); fees drop for older vehicles. Card fee ~2.25%, e-check ~$0.25 (varies by county). Iowa DOT's 'Receive a Renewal Reminder' email signup (mymvd.iowadot.gov/ElectronicRenewalNotification) covers driver's license/ID renewals only; vehicle renewal notices come from county treasurers (iowatreasurers.org reminder emails cover property tax only).

entries.name: Idaho vehicle registration renewal (Idaho DMV online)
entries.parent_company: Idaho Transportation Department - DMV
entries.mail_payment_address: PO Box 7129, Boise, ID 83707-1129
entries.senior_programs: Idaho Disabled Veteran / Service-Connected Disabled Purple Heart plates (ITD 3397): plate fees and registration do not apply (one set per applicant; 100% VA rating letter required).
entries.notes: Renew online (no login needed via OpenServices), by mail, by phone, at county motor vehicle offices, or grocery-store kiosks. Passenger vehicle fees by age: 1-2 yrs $69, 3-6 yrs $57, 7+ yrs $45, plus county admin fees ($3-$14); EV +$140/yr, plug-in hybrid +$75/yr. Idaho has moved to permanent plates with no registration stickers. Idaho self-service renewal kiosks (grocery stores etc.) charge a vendor transaction fee plus card processing fee.

entries.name: Chicago Skyway (missed tolls)
entries.parent_company: Skyway Concession Company
entries.payment_processor: Toll violations in collections handled by PAM (dspayments.com/skyway, 1-866-449-7577)
entries.notes: Accepts I-PASS/E-ZPass; pay a missed toll online. Customer service page gives phone (773) 356-5543 and customerservice@chicagoskyway.org. Customer Service page has a Request a Receipt form (date/time of travel). Skyway Loyalty Program accounts (skywayloyalty.chicagoskyway.org) can opt for auto-replenishment; without it, funds can take up to 24 hours to process. Missed tolls are paid online at paytoll.chicagoskyway.org; I-PASS/E-ZPass users manage statements with their own issuer.

entries.name: Houbolt Road Extension (Joliet)
entries.parent_company: Houbolt Road Extension (Joliet)
entries.notes: Toll bridge; I-PASS/E-ZPass.

entries.name: Illinois license plate sticker renewal (Secretary of State)
entries.parent_company: Illinois Secretary of State - Vehicle Services
entries.senior_programs: Benefit Access Program: seniors 65+ and persons with disabilities meeting income limits receive a reduced license plate renewal fee (see ilsos.gov and Illinois Department on Aging Benefit Access).
entries.notes: Standard passenger sticker $151 (personalized $158, vanity $164). Renew online with Registration ID and PIN from the registration card/notice (call to obtain), by mail, at SOS facilities or at participating currency exchanges/banks.

entries.name: Illinois Tollway I-PASS and Pay By Plate
entries.parent_company: Illinois State Toll Highway Authority
entries.payment_processor: Fiserv CommerceHub card capture on illinoistollway.com (per page source)
entries.senior_programs: I-PASS Assist (https://agency.illinoistollway.com/assist): households at or below 250% of federal poverty guidelines get a free I-PASS with no transponder deposit, as little as $4 initial prepaid tolls and $4 minimum auto-replenishment, plus the standard 50% I-PASS toll discount.
entries.notes: I-PASS (E-ZPass-compatible) accounts, Pay By Plate and unpaid toll invoices are handled on illinoistollway.com. Contact page exists at https://www.illinoistollway.com/contact-us. Help-center FAQ  covers balance check, 'Add funds', automatic replenishment (preauthorized card charge when balance falls below threshold), invoices (first toll invoice 30 days after unpaid toll, further at 60/90 days with fees) and Pay By Plate (set up within 14 days of travel). Card/replenishment changes and statements are managed after signing in online or in the Official Illinois Tollway App; to stop auto-replenishment or close I-PASS call 800-UC-IPASS. The old illinoistollway.com root now serves the agency.illinoistollway.com site. Customer Service FAQ: avoid fees by preauthorizing automatic replenishment from a card or bank. Pay By Plate: register plate and card within 14 days of travel (removing the card disables the service); disputes are made inside the Pay By Plate account. Cash payments at retailers are not accepted for payment plans, Pay By Plate, Notices of Violation or Final Orders. Violation notices are reviewed and paid at dsparkingportal.com/ilves (linked from the Violations page). Close an I-PASS account online, in person or by mail (About I-PASS page). I-PASS Assist customers may have invoice fees dismissed.

entries.name: Cline Avenue Bridge
entries.parent_company: Cline Avenue Bridge
entries.notes: E-ZPass/I-PASS; United Bridge Partners.

entries.name: E-ZPass Indiana (Indiana Toll Road)
entries.parent_company: ITR Concession Company
entries.notes: Indiana Toll Road (I-80/90) E-ZPass accounts. Contact page (from E-ZPass Group list): https://www.indianatollroad.org/contact/. Per those pages: manage account/payment info and past statements in the online E-ZPass account; unpaid tolls payable at secure.indianatollroad.org/pay-toll-charge/. A Dispute a Toll Amount page is available; ITR warns it does NOT send texts, calls or emails requesting unpaid toll payments (scam alert).

entries.name: Indiana BMV vehicle registration renewal (myBMV)
entries.parent_company: Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-888-692-6841 (BMV Contact Center); 1-800-457-8283 listed on home page; text 1-888-311-1846
entries.notes: Renew online via myBMV, at BMV Connect kiosks, or at branches; registration fees cannot be paid through the call center. Card transaction fee $0.40 + 2.06%. Fees include excise tax and county wheel/surtax. 'Where's My Plate?' renewal status in myBMV. Indiana BMV Vehicle Registrations page: owners get a renewal reminder in the mail for each vehicle; BMV also sends text/email reminders, and mailed reminders can be used to renew by mail.

entries.name: K-TAG and toll-by-plate (Kansas Turnpike Authority)
entries.parent_company: Kansas Turnpike Authority
entries.notes: Kansas Turnpike is cashless: K-TAG accounts or bills mailed by plate (Drive Kansas). KTA moved K-TAG and bill-by-plate accounts to DriveKS (driveks.com): one account for transponder and plate-identified vehicles, with statements and bills issued by DriveKS. 800-USE-KTAG converted to digits = 800-873-5824. DriveKS FAQ: postpaid monthly billing - 20 days before the due date customers are notified by email or mailed statement; a payment method on the account pays automatically (auto-pay) or wait for a mailed bill (pay by mail, phone, walk-in or online); disputes within 60 days of travel via the dispute form; account closure by calling customer service. Walk-in centers Wichita, Topeka, Lawrence.

entries.name: Kansas vehicle registration renewal (iKan / county treasurers)
entries.parent_company: Kansas Department of Revenue - Division of Vehicles
entries.payment_processor: PayIt (iKan)
entries.senior_programs: Kansas Disabled Veteran plate: the initial DV plate is issued free at application or renewal (property tax still due); additional DV plates pay standard registration fees.
entries.notes: Renew online with iKan (powered by PayIt) or at your county treasurer's office; property tax on the vehicle is paid with registration. KDOR offers print-at-home renewal notices (PrintRenewals) and iKan online renewal (PayIt); fee chart https://www.kdor.ks.gov/pdf/dmvlicfees.pdf.

entries.name: Kentucky vehicle registration renewal (County Clerk / KYTC online)
entries.parent_company: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet - Division of Motor Vehicle Licensing
entries.notes: Renew online (eligible vehicles; non-refundable service fee as a percentage of total plus $2/vehicle mailing) or at the County Clerk. Vehicle property tax is collected with renewal. KYTC online renewal charges a non-refundable percentage service fee plus $2.00 per vehicle for mailing (AmEx, Discover, MasterCard, VISA). Renewal page lists no email/text reminder program; SCRA may exempt certain military personnel from vehicle property tax (contact county PVA). Military/veterans page on drive.ky.gov.

entries.name: RiverLink (Louisville-Southern Indiana Ohio River Bridges)
entries.parent_company: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet and Indiana Finance Authority
entries.payment_processor: ETC (Electronic Transaction Consultants) hosted portal
entries.senior_programs: RiverLink Fee Forgiveness (once per license plate): open a prepaid account and past-due invoice tolls are rolled back to transponder rates and late fees are waived.
entries.notes: Pay toll invoices or manage prepaid accounts (auto-replenishment min $20; triggers at $6 or 30%) at the RiverLink customer portal. Contact: https://riverlink.com/contactus/; toll disputes FAQ https://riverlink.com/faqs/disputes. Warning on site about scam texts. E-ZPass accepted. Account FAQs cover closing an account (balance refunded) and monthly statements; the RiverLink how-to guide explains Account Settings > Receipts and Statements for past statements and receipts. RiverLink promotes switching to paperless statements (statements always available online; avoids a monthly mailed statement). Two one-way crossings trigger an invoice; unpaid invoices can lead to registration holds and, since May 2026, collections (See If You Owe page). Disputes: fill out and mail the Toll Dispute Form; payment plans are requested in the riteOnline portal (ETC user guide). How-to guides are hosted on the toll vendor's (Electronic Transaction Consultants) help site.

entries.name: GeauxPass (LA 1 and Crescent City Connection)
entries.parent_company: Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development
entries.payment_processor: PayNearMe (cash toll payments at Ace Cash Express, CVS, Dollar General, Family Dollar, Walgreens, Walmart; convenience fees)
entries.senior_programs: Tolling discounts including Disabled Veterans Discount and a local-resident (homestead exemption) discount on LA 1.
entries.notes: Pay violations/toll invoices via the DOTD tolling portal. LA DOTD tolling FAQ: optional Auto Replenishment from card or e-check at a user-defined threshold; fee schedule includes $2.64 monthly statement mailing fee, 3% card processing fee, $2.64 toll invoice mailing fee; one FAQ page covers invoices, replenishment and statements. Customer service centers: Golden Meadow (1821 S. Alex Plaisance Blvd) and New Orleans (2001 Mardi Gras Blvd), per geauxpass.com customer service page. DOTD Tolling FAQ: when the account reaches the low-balance threshold (the minimum opening amount) a deposit is needed; Auto Replenishment by card or e-Check keeps the balance positive. Customers without a prepaid account get a Toll-By-Plate invoice by mail; LA 1 fees: $25 violation-notice administrative fee, $5 final-notice late fee; 3% processing fee on card-funded Belle Chasse (LA 23) transactions. Payment plans and the online web-inquiry form (account closure, statement, collections, discount requests, violation issues) are on the GeauxPass customer portal (pr-ladotd.mroms.us). LA1 Resident Discount requires proof of Grand Isle residency.

entries.name: Lake Pontchartrain Causeway (Causeway toll tag)
entries.parent_company: Greater New Orleans Expressway Commission
entries.payment_processor: in-house (GNOEC causewaytags.us account site)
entries.notes: Causeway toll tag accounts cost $20 to open (prepaid); accounts on charge cards replenish automatically; GeauxPass tags can be linked by calling 985-674-3641. 3% credit card fee. Tolls collected on the North Shore only; tag fare $3.40 vs $6.00 cash/card for 2-axle cars (3% card fee). $20 opens an account (tag + $20 prepaid). Yellow 'Low Bal' light at $10 or less. Payments in person at the North Shore toll-plaza office (7am-5:30pm M-F) or South Shore office (3939 N. Causeway Blvd Suite 400, Metairie, 9-5 M-F), or authorize automatic credit-card replenishment at the low balance (signed authorization required; the page gives no online cancel - call (985) 674-3641). Online account login at causewaytags.us. GeauxPass tags can be linked by phone.

entries.name: Louisiana vehicle registration renewal (OMV Express Lane)
entries.parent_company: Louisiana Office of Motor Vehicles (Dept. of Public Safety)
entries.mail_payment_address: Office of Motor Vehicles, P.O. Box 64886, Baton Rouge, LA 70896
entries.notes: Renew online with the Renewal ID from the mailed notice (if no Renewal ID, you must contact OMV/visit an office); card only, e-commerce service charge applies. Also OMV offices and Public Tag Agents. Registrations commonly 2 years. Renewal notice: the mailed Vehicle Registration Renewal Notice carries a Renewal Identification Number used for online renewal (or use current registration); card payment. OMV page lists no email/text reminder signup.

entries.name: EZDriveMA (E-ZPass MA and Pay By Plate MA)
entries.parent_company: Massachusetts Department of Transportation - Highway Division
entries.notes: Pay a Pay By Plate MA invoice online (login with invoice info). Pay By Plate MA page explains account types: invoice account ($0.60 fee per invoice), registered prepaid with automatic replenishment ($20 initial), registered postpaid automatic payment (charged every 30 days, no invoice), manual postpaid; $1.99 fee applies to some payment transactions. E-ZPass MA account creation: https://www.ezdrivema.com/accountcreationselection. Unpaid tolls can block RMV registration renewal. Customer service page lists phone (877) 627-7745 and written inquiries to EZDriveMA Customer Service Center, 27 Midstate Drive, Auburn, MA 01501-1800. E-ZPass MA Individual Application PDF: automatic replenishment from checking or credit/debit card stays in force until E-ZPass MA receives written notice of termination; manual replenishment option; mailed account statements carry a fee (statements otherwise online after sign-in). Customer service 1-877-627-7745. Fee Schedule: E-ZPass MA statements are free online and $0.60 each by mail (duplicate statements extra). Pay By Plate MA Registered accounts use automatic replenishment from a card or checking account ($20 initial prepayment); unregistered drivers get a Pay By Plate MA invoice. Unpaid invoices can lead to late fees and non-renewal of license/registration. Disputes can be made online in the account (Customer Service page). Account agreement: close an E-ZPass MA or registered PBP account by notifying the CSC in writing.

entries.name: Massachusetts RMV registration renewal (myRMV)
entries.parent_company: Massachusetts Registry of Motor Vehicles (MassDOT)
entries.notes: Renew online at myRMV (card; need plate number, owner name/DOB, ZIP) or by mail to the RMV Mail-In Registration Department. URLs from official search results only.

entries.name: E-ZPass Maryland / DriveEzMD (Video Tolls, Pay-By-Plate)
entries.parent_company: Maryland Transportation Authority
entries.notes: Pay a Notice of Toll Due (NOTD) or find tolls by plate at the Pay Tolls Now page; account/payment options page describes E-ZPass and Pay-By-Plate account types. DriveEzMD mobile app: https://driveezmd.com/faq/driveezmds-mobile-app/. Contact: https://www.driveezmd.com/contact-us/. Unpaid video tolls can result in MVA registration flags. E-ZPass MD FAQ explains automatic credit-card replenishment when balance dips below threshold (variable or fixed replenishment), and that no monthly statement is generated if you did not travel; historic statements are in the online account. Discount plans (commuter, Baltimore Region, Shoreline) are on the discount-plans page. MDTA operates Maryland toll facilities and bills through DriveEzMD (E-ZPass MD, Pay-By-Plate, Video Tolls). E-ZPass FAQ: monthly statements are generated only for months with toll activity and are the toll receipt; history is under Transactions in the online account; call to switch to automatic card replenishment. Pay-By-Plate accounts (card required, auto-charged) get no statements of any kind; history is online. Video Toll Installment Plan reduces civil penalties, releases MVA holds and lets drivers pay toll debt over time (defaulting reinstates the original debt; unpaid balances may go to the Maryland Central Collection Unit). Sample Notice of Toll Due and Final Toll Violation Notice PDFs are on the Downloads page.

entries.name: Maryland MVA vehicle registration renewal
entries.parent_company: Maryland Department of Transportation - Motor Vehicle Administration
entries.mail_payment_address: MVA, 6601 Ritchie Highway N.E., Glen Burnie, MD 21062
entries.notes: Renew online 24/7 via myMVA, by mail (if indicated on notice), in person (appointment) or at MVA kiosks. 1-, 2- or 3-year registration periods; fees by vehicle type/weight. Unpaid tolls/tickets or emissions flags block renewal. MVA mails a renewal notice when due; registrations run 1-3 years; the notice states whether mail renewal is available. Military service members and veterans may get registration/titling/inspection exemptions or extensions (MVA military page).

entries.name: E-ZPass Maine (Maine Turnpike Authority)
entries.parent_company: Maine Turnpike Authority
entries.notes: E-ZPass Maine portal handles account payments, non-account (missed toll) payments and violations. Maine Turnpike converting toward cashless tolling; non-account payment page explains paying tolls without an account. Maine Turnpike E-ZPass FAQ: add funds online 24/7 or enroll in Automatic Replenishment (card charged when balance falls below a set level); last 24 months of statements online, printed monthly statements for a fee. Personal Account User's Guide and Personal Terms PDFs  cover changing payment method, suspension/closing the account in writing. Maine Turnpike is not pay-by-plate: drivers who pass without cash or a valid E-ZPass must pay the toll online or with the Non-Account Toll Payment form (or call 1-888-MTA-PASS) to avoid a violation notice and fees; MTA cannot grant driver exemptions. MTA FAQ lists the low-balance points that trigger replenishment (e.g., below $30 for accounts with three transponders; 25% of minimum for business accounts). Volume discount for Maine Class 1 E-ZPass commuters; no senior discount.

entries.name: Maine vehicle registration renewal (Rapid Renewal / municipal town office)
entries.parent_company: Maine Secretary of State - Bureau of Motor Vehicles
entries.service_area_detail: Statewide; municipal excise tax collected by towns
entries.notes: Rapid Renewal online if your municipality participates (pays municipal excise tax + state fee together); otherwise renew at the town office (excise tax) or BMV branch. Standard passenger registration $35/year. Sign up for registration reminders online.

entries.name: Ambassador Bridge
entries.parent_company: Detroit International Bridge Company
entries.service_area_detail: International bridge Detroit, MI - Windsor, ON; Premier Card prepaid program for cars, A-PASS for commercial
entries.notes: Premier Card Program (discounted prepaid tolls for frequent auto crossers), 'Pay An Invoice' and account login at cp.ambassadorbridge.com.

entries.name: Bay City Bridge Partners (Liberty and Independence bridges, BC-PASS)
entries.parent_company: Bay City Bridge Partners (Liberty and Independence bridges, BC-PASS)
entries.notes: BC-PASS and E-ZPass.

entries.name: Detroit-Windsor Tunnel
entries.parent_company: Detroit Windsor Tunnel LLC
entries.service_area_detail: International tunnel between Detroit, MI and Windsor, ON; prepaid commuter accounts
entries.mail_payment_address: Detroit Windsor Tunnel, 100 E Jefferson Ave, Detroit, MI 48226
entries.notes: Toll rates, FAQs and 'Manage Your Account' for prepaid commuter accounts. Border crossing - tolls mostly paid at the booth; seniors who cross often may hold a prepaid account.

entries.name: Mackinac Bridge (MacPass)
entries.parent_company: Mackinac Bridge Authority
entries.mail_payment_address: Mackinac Bridge Authority, N 415 I-75, St. Ignace, MI 49781
entries.senior_programs: MacPass commuter discount: passenger vehicles making a northbound and southbound trip within 36 hours pay $4 for the first trip and $0 for the return (same tag/vehicle).
entries.notes: MacPass prepaid accounts for frequent crossers; E-ZPass acceptance per bridge authority. MacPass FAQ: prepaid account that does not expire; setup $47 personal ($7 fee + $40 balance); reload online by card/checking, in an open toll lane, or at the 24-hour customer service window (min $20 personal; 2.3% card fee); monthly statements emailed and viewable under 'Account Activity' online/app; to close the account contact the Authority with name/address/phone/account number. No automatic replenishment is described - MacPass deposits are manual. Correction: MacPass now offers Auto Rebill (FAQ #10): log in at macpass.mackinacbridge.org > Online Payment > Auto Rebill tab, add a debit/credit card and toggle Enable Auto Rebill (Edit to change). One-time online deposits: $20 minimum personal, $50 business; 2.3% card service fee; emailed receipts. Account agreement: disputes in writing to the Revenue Auditor within 60 days of the transaction; MBA closes the account on written request. Mackinac Bridge has no toll-by-plate (pay at the booth).

entries.name: Michigan tab and plate renewal (Secretary of State)
entries.parent_company: Michigan Department of State (Secretary of State)
entries.phone_customer_service: 517-636-5872 (renewal fee information line, per SOS tab-and-plate renewal page)
entries.notes: Renew tabs online (e-Services), at self-service stations (kiosks in retail stores), by mail, or at an SOS office. Fee based on vehicle MSRP and age for newer vehicles; use renewal fee calculator. Renewal due on owner's birthday. Renewal page gives 517-636-5872 for renewal-fee amounts; mail renewals go to the Michigan Department of State Renewal by Mail Unit (see page for full address). Replacement registration if address was wrong: $5. Michigan SOS FAQ: renewal forms cannot be resent - without the notice, renew online (plate number + last 4 of VIN), at a self-service station ($4.25 fee) or a branch; renewal fee by Renewal Fee Calculator or 517-636-5872. Mail renewals: Michigan Department of State, 7064 Crowner Drive, Lansing, MI 48918. Veteran plates carry no added fee.

entries.name: Sault Ste. Marie International Bridge (International Bridge Administration)
entries.parent_company: International Bridge Administration (MDOT) / Sault Ste. Marie Bridge Authority
entries.service_area_detail: International bridge Sault Ste. Marie, MI - Sault Ste. Marie, ON; prepaid discount toll accounts
entries.notes: Toll Account Login, full-fare/discount/RV auto toll rates, accounts@saultbridge.com.

entries.name: E-ZPass Minnesota (MnDOT E-ZPass lanes)
entries.parent_company: Minnesota Department of Transportation
entries.notes: Manage account and add money at ezpassmn.net. Email customerservice@ezpassmn.net. MnDOT 'How it works' page: card on file auto-replenishes when balance falls below the threshold (change threshold/amount via customer service); detailed monthly statements emailed (mailed for a small fee); balances viewable online anytime. Agreement PDF  governs closing the account. Page warns of fake text messages impersonating MnDOT/E-ZPass. How E-ZPass Works: when the balance drops below the threshold the card on file is charged a set replenishment amount; customers can keep the required minimums or choose their own threshold/replenishment amounts (raise them before out-of-state trips). Detailed monthly statements are emailed (mailed statements for a small fee); no statement in months without use. Minnesota E-ZPass lanes are optional express lanes; there is no toll-by-plate billing or payment plan.

entries.name: Minnesota vehicle tab renewal (DVS)
entries.parent_company: Minnesota Department of Public Safety - Driver and Vehicle Services
entries.mail_payment_address: Driver and Vehicle Services Renewal, P.O. Box 64587, St. Paul, MN 55164-0587
entries.senior_programs: Minnesota: registration exemptions for 100% disabled veterans and active-duty members, plus sales tax exemption when VA pays for vehicle modifications.
entries.notes: Renew online, by mail, at deputy registrar offices, or at DVS kiosks (https://minnesotadvsnow.com/). Registration tax is based on vehicle base value and age. DVS: the registration renewal notice arrives by mail or email before expiration and lists the exact fees and taxes for the vehicle.

entries.name: Missouri license plate renewal (Department of Revenue)
entries.parent_company: Missouri Department of Revenue - Motor Vehicle Bureau
entries.senior_programs: Missouri Disabled Veteran plates: one free set with no specialty, transfer, processing or replacement fees (late renewal penalty still applies); additional DV plates pay normal fees.
entries.notes: Renew online, by mail, by phone, or at any license office. Requires paid personal property tax receipt (or waiver), insurance, and safety/emissions inspection where required. Card convenience fee 2.0% + $0.25. Sign up for electronic renewal notifications. MoNotify electronic notifications: renewal notices by email and/or text (must confirm the text subscription); one email and one mobile number per record.

entries.name: NC Quick Pass and Bill by Mail
entries.parent_company: North Carolina Turnpike Authority (NCDOT)
entries.mail_payment_address: NC Quick Pass, P.O. Box 100020, Atlanta, GA 30348-0020 (do not send cash)
entries.notes: Pay NC Quick Pass accounts and Bill by Mail invoices; 'What if I don't pay' page: https://www.ncquickpass.com/what-if-i-dont-pay/. Accepts E-ZPass, SunPass, Peach Pass. 919-388-3279 is the fax number, not a phone line. Toll invoices (Bill by Mail) cost double the NC Quick Pass rate; unpaid invoices add processing fees/civil penalties and can trigger a DMV registration hold. An NC Quick Pass account pays tolls automatically from a prepaid balance. Email statements are turned on in the account Profile > Statements section (go-paperless page). Invoice explainer: envelopes-and-invoices page. NCTA bills through NC Quick Pass / Bill by Mail. Go Paperless page: Profile > Statements to switch to email statements; statements stay online for two years (Updating Your Account FAQ). Accounts 101: the card on file is charged automatically when the balance drops below the threshold. To change payment or close the account, log in and send a request through the Contact section (creates a case ID). Bill by Mail invoices add a $6 processing fee per invoice after the first, and a $25 civil penalty from the 3rd invoice; disputes within 30 days of the statement or invoice. Pay invoices and add funds in cash at NC Quick Pass stations inside participating License Plate Agencies or MoneyGram/CVS kiosks.

Vehicle property tax is collected with registration (Tag & Tax Together). Late fee up to $25 after expiration. Inspection required in many counties. The 'NC Combined Vehicle Registration Renewal and Property Tax Notice' shows the county vehicle property tax section (tax county, value, rates, county contact for appeals) together with registration fees; both are paid together at renewal.

Close Account Request Form PDF  is the official way to close/stop the account. NH E-ZPass customer guide: e-mail is the recommended statement delivery (add statements.ezpassnh.com to your address book); mailed statements are quarterly, and individual accounts pay $2.00 per monthly paper statement; statements can be discontinued by calling the CSC. Credit-card accounts auto-replenish at the replenishment point.

entries.notes: Open account: https://www.ezpassnj.com/en/signup/signup.shtml. Toll violations/invoices (including toll-by-mail notices on NJ roads) paid via violation inquiry. NJ E-ZPass mobile app (iOS id1499600253; Android com.conduent.ezpassnj). NJTA contact: https://www.njta.gov/contact-us/ (732-750-5300 x8750). Processor: Conduent-operated CSC. Signed-in account menu has Payment > Update Payment Method and Activity > Statements/Transactions. Account closure/refund terms are in the Individual Terms & Conditions PDF (effective June 2026). FAQ: paper statements are optional; under My Account > Account Profile > Statement Delivery choose email or mail monthly, or stop statements, any time. Auto Pay replenishment by credit/debit card or checking/savings. One lookup page (violation notice or toll bill number plus plate) handles Toll-By-Plate bills, invoices and violations (pay or dispute), and existing payment plans (plan number plus email). Immediate Payment (bank pay-by-bank) FAQ explains declining an immediate-payment request for unpaid tolls.

Site is a JavaScript app. Individual Account Application PDF  documents credit-card or checking-account automatic replenishment, check/cash replenishment by mail, statement delivery choice and fee for re-retrieving past statements; terms-and-conditions page  governs changing/stopping replenishment and closing accounts (refund after tags returned). Tolls By Mail bill payments by mail: Tolls by Mail Payment Processing Center, PO Box 15183, Albany, NY 12212-5183; cash at retailers via bill barcode (map.payithere.com); Tolls NY mobile app for iOS/Android (per Thruway page). Toll payer advocates: NYS Thruway Office of the Toll Payer Advocate assists customers unable to resolve Thruway toll issues through the E-ZPass NY/Tolls by Mail center (not for DMV suspensions - Thruway DMV Suspension Team 718-313-9414)

entries.name: New York DMV vehicle registration renewal

entries.notes: Renew online up to one year past expiration (card), by mail with renewal notice (MV-3/OP-3) or MV-82, or at a DMV office. Temporary registration printable after online renewal. Parking/toll/scofflaw holds and lapsed insurance or inspection block renewal. Registrations are 2 years. Fee shown on renewal notice. dmv.ny.gov blocks curl but serves to WebFetch. The renewal fee is shown on the renewal notice and on the online renewal screen; fee-exempt registrations cannot be renewed online.

Account/autopay/statement fields point at the E-ZPass NY system that actually bills these bridges.

E-ZPass accounts, autopay and statements are E-ZPass NY functions. Thruway Office of the Toll Payer Advocate for unresolved toll issues; E-ZPass NY discount plans (Thruway commuter plans; E-ZPass NY tag transactions discounted vs. Tolls by Mail).

PANYNJ Toll Resources: Toll Payer Advocates (TPA) help resolve toll issues; E-ZPass discounts (e.g., Staten Island Bridges Plan) only for NY/NJ E-ZPass accounts; Tolls by Mail payable without card/bank account at retail store locations.

entries.name: E-ZPass Ohio (Ohio Turnpike)
entries.parent_company: Ohio Turnpike and Infrastructure Commission
entries.mail_payment_address: Unpaid Toll Invoices (check/money order): Ohio Turnpike and Infrastructure Commission, P.O. Box 94672, Cleveland, OH 44101; account closure/transponder returns: P.O. Box 460, Berea, OH 44017
entries.notes: Pay unpaid tolls (toll-by-plate invoices) and manage E-ZPass accounts at ezpassoh.com; hub page explains options. Account information/statements are online 24/7; close account by returning transponder to the Berea P.O. Box. E-ZPass FAQ: when the balance reaches or falls below $10 per transponder the card on file is charged to replenish; statements are generated monthly on the account anniversary date and transactions can be exported (PDF/CSV) online; paper statements by mail carry a processing fee. Unpaid Toll Invoices are paid online at ezpassoh.com or by check; disputes/hearing requests are filed through Pay Your Unpaid Toll or Contact Us at ezpassoh.com. Toll system modernization page: plate-only trips are invoiced at the Unpaid Toll rate, due in 25 days; after 30 days a second invoice adds $5 per toll; after 90 days collections and an Ohio BMV registration block.

entries.name: Ohio BMV vehicle registration renewal (OPLATES / BMV Online Services)
entries.parent_company: Ohio Bureau of Motor Vehicles
entries.notes: Renew online at BMV Online Services (oplates.com redirects here), by mail, at deputy registrar license agencies, or at self-service kiosks. Multi-year registration available. Emissions (E-Check) required in some NE Ohio counties. Ohio BMV 'Go Paperless!' (OPLATES notification signup) replaces the mailed renewal reminder with email.

entries.name: Oklahoma vehicle registration (tag) renewal (Service Oklahoma)
entries.parent_company: Service Oklahoma
entries.mail_payment_address: Service Oklahoma, P.O. Box 11415, Oklahoma City, OK 73136
entries.senior_programs: Service Oklahoma: 100% disabled veterans (VA letter or sales-tax exemption card) are eligible for reduced pricing on registration; out-of-state active duty can get late-penalty waivers.
entries.notes: Renew online via Navigate OK, by mail, or at a licensed operator (tag agency). Annual registration fee declines with vehicle age. Sign up for renewal email reminders. Failure to receive a renewal reminder notice does not excuse late renewal; update your renewal notice email at navigate.ok.gov.

entries.name: Pikepass and PlatePay (Oklahoma Turnpike Authority)
entries.parent_company: Oklahoma Turnpike Authority
entries.payment_processor: PayNearMe (cash payments at retail stores, per OTA 2016 announcement)
entries.notes: Oklahoma turnpikes are cashless: Pikepass (prepaid, auto-replenish) or PlatePay invoices mailed to the registered owner at a higher rate. Pikepass site is a JavaScript app. Toll User's Toolkit has 'How to Read your PIKEPASS Statement', mailing addresses and forms. License & Use Agreement PDF: card/bank accounts auto-replenish at an OTA-set minimum balance; cash/check accounts must replenish manually; review statements within 30 days; negative accounts >90 days get a 25% fee and termination. PlatePay guest payments at platepay.pikepass.com/guest-payments (JavaScript). PIKEPASS License and Use Agreement: automatic-replenishment accounts are charged to the authorized card or bank account when the balance reaches the minimum; cash/check accounts get a Payment Request at the minimum balance; overdrawn/terminated accounts go to external collections. Review the Statement of Toll Activity and report errors within 30 days of the Statement Delivery Date; PlatePay trips can be assigned to an account and show as Video Tolls. Close by written request; the Toll Kit page lists a Close Account Form plus EFT and credit-card authorization forms.

entries.name: Oregon DMV vehicle registration renewal (DMV2U)
entries.parent_company: Oregon Department of Transportation - DMV
entries.senior_programs: Oregon Disabled Veteran plates (Form 6736): reduced disabled-veteran registration fee of $15 plus the $26 plate fee for qualifying disabled veterans.
entries.notes: Renew online at DMV2U, by mail, or in person. 2-year registrations for most passenger vehicles. DEQ emissions test required in Portland and Medford areas. DMV2U 'Lost Your Renewal Reminder?' link lets owners request help when the mailed reminder is missing.

entries.name: Pennsylvania Turnpike E-ZPass and Toll By Plate
entries.parent_company: Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-877-736-6727 (say 'Customer Service', then 1 for E-ZPass, 3 for Toll By Plate)
entries.mail_payment_address: PA Turnpike Toll By Plate, PO Box 645631, Pittsburgh, PA 15264-5254
entries.payment_processor: TransCore (E-ZPass and Toll By Plate customer portal at ezpass.csc.paturnpike.com); cash pay slips via KUBRA (7-Eleven, CVS, Dollar General and other retailers)
entries.notes: Pay a Bill page covers Toll By Plate invoices and E-ZPass; E-ZPass accounts use automatic replenishment from a card or automatic payment from a bank account ($35 per transponder minimum replenish; $3 annual fee noted). PA Toll Pay app: https://www.paturnpike.com/toll-by-plate/pa-toll-pay-app. Unpaid tolls can lead to PennDOT registration suspension. Help Center  covers E-ZPass bank-debit replenishment (min $35 per transponder when balance hits $10 per transponder) and disputes using the E-ZPass account statement; statements themselves are in the signed-in account. A registered Toll By Plate account gives email notifications when an invoice is ready, online viewing/dispute, and 15% off tolls with AutoPay. Help Center: E-ZPass ACH replenishment debits at least $35 per transponder whenever the balance reaches $10 or less per transponder. Customers in revenue enforcement or collections may qualify for a payment plan by calling 877-736-6727; registration-suspension appeals must be filed within 30 days (appeals cannot reduce the amount owed). Toll Dispute Form available online or as PDF.

entries.name: Pennsylvania vehicle registration renewal (PennDOT)
entries.parent_company: Pennsylvania Department of Transportation - Driver and Vehicle Services

PennDOT Retired Status Registration: retired owners who meet the income requirement pay a small Retired Person's processing fee instead of the full registration fee (renewable online; veterans' benefit payments are excluded from income per the page).
entries.notes: Renew online, by mail, or at authorized online agents; PA no longer issues registration stickers. Registrations suspended for unpaid tolls (PA Turnpike) or parking tickets. The PennDOT renewal page also has the PA Senior Citizens Driver's License and Registration Services fact sheet.

Hacienda's Directorio de Colecturías lists Renovación de marbetes vehículos de motor, marbete purchase certifications, traffic fines (multas) and ACAA stamps among colecturía services, and links a list of banks and cooperatives that sell marbetes. entries.parent_company: Fort Bend County Toll Road Authority
entries.senior_programs: FBCTRA Disabled Veterans Discount Program: discounted/waived tolls for Disabled Veterans, Purple Heart and Legion of Valor recipients with qualifying Texas plates and a registered toll tag (registration processed in about 2 business days).
entries.notes: Violations/invoices paid via the FBTRCSC customer service site; EZ TAG/TxTag/TollTag accepted. Fort Bend toll roads are toll-tag only (no cash, no pay-by-mail); tagless trips become violations payable via the Violation Payment Center (855) 999-2024 / FBTRCSC.com. Fort Bend toll roads are electronic toll tag only - no cash and no pay-by-mail; drivers without a tag get an initial toll violation notice payable at the Violation Payment Center (FBTRCSC.com, 855-999-2024, Mon-Fri 8am-5pm). Tag accounts (statements, replenishment) are with the tag issuer (EZ TAG, TxTag, TollTag).

entries.name: NTTA TollTag and ZipCash (North Texas Tollway Authority)
entries.parent_company: North Texas Tollway Authority
entries.mail_payment_address: NTTA, P.O. Box 260928 (Plano, TX) - see bill
entries.notes: ZipCash (pay-by-mail) bills on 25-day cycle: pay online at ssptrips.ntta.org; late fees $10 first notice, $25 second notice. ZipCash autopay gives 25% off NTTA roads; TollTag customers pay about half ZipCash rates. Habitual violators can face vehicle bans. ZipCash customers can enroll in monthly automatic payments (saves 25% on NTTA roads) and request emailed monthly statements; to cancel email billing uncheck the preference in the account (pay-your-bill page). Statement shows account ID and PIN used for online access. Get a TollTag: when the balance reaches $5 the card is charged $10 or $20 (single-vehicle accounts). Pay Your Bill: ZipCash notices give 25 days to pay; a $10 first-notice and $25 second-notice late fee follow, then collections; payment plans may be available by opening a TollTag account or resolving issues on an existing one; habitual violators can face registration blocks and should call NTTA about a Settlement Agreement (county tax offices cannot help). Email statements: set the preference in the account; uncheck it to cancel.

entries.name: Texas vehicle registration renewal (TxDMV / county tax offices)
entries.parent_company: Texas Department of Motor Vehicles
entries.notes: Base fee $50.75 for cars/light trucks plus local fees; $1 discount for online renewal. Renew online (TxDMV or Texas by Texas https://txt.texas.gov/dmv/vehicle-registration-renewal), by mail to the county tax office, or in person (county tax office or approved substations such as some grocery stores). Passing inspection required in emissions counties ($2.75 emissions fee). Sign up for eReminders and paperless renewal notices. EVs pay $200 annual fee. TxDMV eReminder: sign up with plate number, last 4 of VIN and email for renewal reminder emails; 'Go Paperless' electronic renewal notices replace the mailed notice.

entries.name: TEXpress Lanes (LBJ, NTE and NTE 35W - Dallas/Fort Worth)
entries.parent_company: LBJ Infrastructure Group / NTE Mobility Partners (Cintra)
entries.phone_customer_service: (877) 525-3979 (TEXpress customer service); billing handled by NTTA
entries.payment_processor: NTTA (TollTag / ZipCash billing)
entries.senior_programs: TEXpress Toll Assistance Program (pilot): free tolls on LBJ/NTE/NTE 35W TEXpress Lanes for North Texans enrolled in SNAP or WIC. TxDOT/NTTA veteran discount programs also honored.
entries.notes: Billing page: NTTA handles all billing and customer service for TEXpress Lanes (pay ZipCash bills at ntta.org). TEXpress Toll Assistance Program (pilot): North Texans enrolled in SNAP or WIC can get free tolls on the TEXpress Lanes (eligibility details on the program page); HOV discount also available. TEXpress tolls post to NTTA TollTag (or other Texas tag) accounts and ZipCash bills are issued by NTTA. TEXpress bills, disputes and toll-tag service are handled by NTTA (972-818-NTTA). Drivers without a tag get an NTTA ZipCash bill (video toll premiums up to 100% higher) payable online, by phone, mail or at NTTA Customer Service Centers; ZipCash late fees $10/$25; payment plans via NTTA. TollTag replenishes $10 or $20 when the balance hits $5. HOV 50% discount with the GoCarma app.
