entries.payment_processor: Virginia Toll Processing Center (tollroadsinvirginia.com); collections by PAM (pamcollections.com)
entries.notes: Manage E-ZPass VA account (auto-replenishment) at myaccount.ezpassva.com. Missed a toll: https://www.tollroadsinvirginia.com/MissedToll/FindFacility; general payment page https://www.tollroadsinvirginia.com/Home/MakeAPayment. Covers VDOT-operated facilities; privately operated facilities (495/95 Express Lanes, Dulles Greenway, Elizabeth River Tunnels, Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel) have separate billing. E-ZPass VA FAQ and Contact pages: automatic replenishment when balance hits the low-balance level (recommended $35 per transponder or average monthly use); adjust threshold by logging in or calling; reps Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, 24-hour automated line, chat; TTY via Virginia Relay 1-800-828-1120. Customer Agreement PDF: quarterly/monthly statements and online review; either party may terminate; return transponders; refund of remaining balance within 30 days. About E-ZPass: automatic replenishment usually within 24 hours of reaching the low-balance threshold (typically $10 per transponder); FAQ: monthly/quarterly statements free online, mailed statements from $2/month; optional account-balance text alerts from 1-844-548-0707 (text STOP or change settings online). Missed tolls on Virginia Toll Processing Center roads can be paid online within six days; Virginia E-ZPass customers can dispute invoices/notices online. Violation FAQ: payment plans are not available - unpaid balances escalate; collections via PAM (pamcollections.com).

entries.name: Elizabeth River Crossings (Downtown/Midtown Tunnels)
entries.parent_company: Elizabeth River Crossings OpCo
entries.notes: Hampton Roads tunnels; toll-by-plate invoices and E-ZPass. This facility does not run its own prepaid accounts for most drivers; E-ZPass accounts are held with E-ZPass Virginia (VDOT). Toll invoices/missed tolls are still paid through this facility's own pay page. ERC offers a 'Toll Relief' program for low-income Norfolk/Portsmouth residents. ERC tunnel E-ZPass statements and replenishment are handled by E-ZPass Virginia (free online statements; auto-replenish at about $10 per transponder).

entries.name: Pocahontas Parkway (Route 895)
entries.parent_company: Pocahontas Parkway (Route 895) operator
entries.mail_payment_address: Pocahontas Parkway, P.O. Box 7693, Richmond, VA 23231
entries.notes: Pay missed tolls and violations via the payment portal (need name, statement number and plate). Fees if unpaid: missed toll no fee, first invoice $12.50, second invoice $25, collections $100. E-ZPass accepted. This facility does not run its own prepaid accounts for most drivers; E-ZPass accounts are held with E-ZPass Virginia (VDOT). Toll invoices/missed tolls are still paid through this facility's own pay page. Make a Payment page: pay missed tolls online by license plate, by phone (804) 822-3458, by check to P.O. Box 7693, Richmond, VA 23231, or drop cash/check at the office; unpaid tolls can grow to as much as $600 in fees and penalties. FAQ: wait at least 48 hours after a missed toll before paying online. Dispute page explains common causes (plate not on E-ZPass account, low balance - allow 24-48 hours for replenishment, transponder mounting).

entries.name: RMTA / GoRMTA (Powhite Parkway, Downtown Expressway, Boulevard Bridge - Richmond)
entries.parent_company: Richmond Metropolitan Transportation Authority
entries.notes: RMTA roads went all-electronic; drivers without E-ZPass get Pay-By-Plate statements (moving to a 30-day statement cycle) payable on the GoRMTA portal (gormta.org), which also offers a GoRMTA account and a Missed Toll payment option. E-ZPass Virginia accounts pay automatically. 'Received a statement' page explains Pay-By-Plate statements and payment online (Pay Tolls portal) or by phone 1-833-990-5405. This facility does not run its own prepaid accounts for most drivers; E-ZPass accounts are held with E-ZPass Virginia (VDOT). Toll invoices/missed tolls are still paid through this facility's own pay page. Received a Statement page explains RMTA Pay-By-Plate statements; statements are issued about every 30 days and the first new-cycle statement includes new tolls, fines on earlier unpaid tolls and payments/credits. Cash still accepted at the Downtown Expressway 6:30am-9pm. Prepaid GoRMTA accounts (gormta.org) let drivers prepay and track tolls without E-ZPass but do not get E-ZPass discount rates.

entries.name: South Norfolk Jordan Bridge
entries.parent_company: South Norfolk Jordan Bridge
entries.notes: E-ZPass; toll-by-plate (United Bridge Partners)

entries.name: Virginia DMV vehicle registration renewal
entries.parent_company: Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles
entries.senior_programs: Virginia: Disabled Veteran Sales and Use Tax Exemption for qualifying disabled veterans' vehicles; local registration fee exemptions/discounts vary by locality (e.g., Virginia Beach chart).
entries.notes: Renew online ($1 discount), by mail, phone, or in person/DMV Select. 1-, 2- or 3-year renewals (2-yr $3 online discount; 3-yr $4). Email and text reminders available. Local personal property tax is billed separately by the city/county; some localities block renewal for unpaid local taxes/parking tickets. Virginia DMV emails/texts renewal reminders (sign up in My Account with DMV customer number or SSN, DOB and PIN); renewing online saves $1, plus $2/$3 off for 2- or 3-year registrations.

entries.name: USVI Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV) - vehicle registration
entries.parent_company: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands
entries.service_area_detail: Vehicle registration renewals, duplicate registrations/titles/plates, driver's licenses and IDs.
entries.payment_processor: MyBMV portal (MyBMV.bmv.vi.gov): register, pick account, pay, receive emailed receipt; documents mailed or picked up
entries.notes: Online services page lists registration renewal and duplicates via MyBMV. Fees: https://bmv.vi.gov/fees/. Territory-wide Customer Contact Center: https://gviservices.servicenowservices.com/csp.

entries.name: Vermont DMV registration renewal
entries.parent_company: Vermont Agency of Transportation - Department of Motor Vehicles
entries.mail_payment_address: DMV, PO Box 1308, Williston, VT 05495-1308 (only for renewals using the mailed renewal notice)
entries.notes: Renew online via the DMV portal, by mail with the renewal notice envelope, or in person. 1- or 2-year registrations. Renew by mail with the signed renewal notice and check/money order for the amount on the notice using the included envelope; permanent registration in about ten business days. Disabled Veteran and other military plates require form VG-168.

entries.name: Good To Go! (Washington State tolling)
entries.parent_company: Washington State Department of Transportation
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: 1-866-936-8246 (pay a toll bill or get a missing statement ID by phone)
entries.payment_processor: ETAN Tolling (back-office/customer site, per page metadata)
entries.senior_programs: WSDOT Low-Income Toll Discount (starting fall 2026, SR 509 and SR 167 Expressways only): household income up to 200% FPL. One-time forgiveness of late fees and civil penalties - call 1-866-936-8246 before paying. Payment plans currently unavailable. No senior/disability toll exemption in Washington.
entries.notes: Good To Go! accounts (automatic payments) and Pay By Mail/pay-a-toll for SR 520, SR 99 tunnel, Tacoma Narrows Bridge, I-405/SR 167 express lanes. Unpaid tolls block DOL tab renewal. WSDOT Good To Go! accounts page  explains Pre-Paid vs Pay As You Go accounts (tolls charged to card twice a month), short-term accounts that auto-close within 90 days, Pay By Mail bills (+$2 per toll vs account rate), late fees/civil penalties and disputes. To turn off auto-pay or cancel recurring bank payments, contact customer service (per the Good To Go! Terms & Conditions PDF, at least 7 business days before the next draft). Customer service offers interpretation in ~230 languages. WSDOT accounts page: Pre-Paid accounts start with $30 and auto-refill by card when low (or refill on chosen days by e-check); Pay As You Go accounts are charged twice a month; email statements are free, paper statements cost extra. Pay By Mail is $2 more per toll; unpaid bills add a $5 late fee, a $40 civil penalty per toll after 80 days, and a DOL registration hold if a civil penalty is unpaid 20 days. Checks payable to Good To Go! with the Customer ID from the statement or notice. ETAN Tolling (back-office/customer site, per page metadata).

entries.name: Washington vehicle tab renewal (Department of Licensing)
entries.parent_company: Washington State Department of Licensing
entries.notes: Renew online via License eXpress (with or without account), by mail, or at vehicle licensing offices (county auditor/subagents). Unpaid tolls (Good To Go) and tickets must be paid first. Fees include RTA excise tax in Sound Transit district. Email renewal reminders available. DOL Renewal Notices page: since August 2025 vehicle renewal notices arrive by email or postcard; sign up for email reminders (from noreply@notifications.dol.wa.gov) or opt back to postcards in My Account/License Express; mail renewals with the postcard and a check to the address on the card.

entries.name: Wisconsin DMV license plate renewal
entries.parent_company: Wisconsin Department of Transportation - DMV
entries.mail_payment_address: WisDOT, P.O. Box 3279 (full address on renewal notice/plate renewal page)
entries.payment_processor: Tyler Payment Services ($0.15 merchant fee)
entries.notes: Renew online (card, PayPal or ACH - ACH no convenience fee), by mail, at third-party renewal service providers (up to $16.25 service fee) or DMV service centers ($3 counter fee). Email/text renewal notices available. Wisconsin eNotify: renewal reminders by email and text for eligible vehicles; after confirming the signup email you stop getting mailed notices. Lost notice: use the Substitute Renewal Notice form MV2016.

entries.name: West Virginia DMV registration renewal
entries.parent_company: West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles
entries.mail_payment_address: West Virginia DMV, P.O. Box 17110, Charleston, WV 25317
entries.senior_programs: West Virginia Disabled Veteran plates (DMV-48-D): qualifying disabled veterans are exempt from the vehicle registration fee under WV Code 17A-10-8 (personalization $15/yr).
entries.notes: Renew online ('Skip the Trip'), by mail with renewal notice, insurance info and personal property tax receipt, or in person. 1- or 2-year renewals. Registration Renewal Notice (DMV-44, PDF) shows the mail-in renewal: $51.50 for one year or $103 for two, county personal property tax receipt or exemption required, mail to WV DMV, PO Box 17110, Charleston, WV 25317.

entries.name: WV E-ZPass (West Virginia Parkways Authority)
entries.parent_company: West Virginia Parkways Authority
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-800-206-6222 (E-ZPass Customer Service Center, Mon-Fri 8am-4:30pm); WVPA main 304-926-1900
entries.mail_payment_address: West Virginia Parkways Authority, Customer Service Center, 3310 Piedmont Road, P.O. Box 1469, Charleston, WV 25325-1469
entries.senior_programs: Single Fee Discount Plan: unlimited annual WV Turnpike travel for one flat fee (auto-renewal optional) - most WV drivers save with it.
entries.notes: Pay tolls and notices online; sign up for WV E-ZPass (single-fee discount plans for WV residents). WV E-ZPass Personal Account Agreement PDF: automatic replenishment and optional automatic renewal of the Single Fee Discount Plan; to stop auto-renew call 1-800-206-6222; monthly statements list every transaction; cancel in writing or online and return transponder. Customer Service page routes: pay a bill or violation, dispute a charge, or request a receipt or statement (online contact form on wv.accessgov.com). Pay-By-Plate accounts (WV Turnpike only) bill tolls to a card on file; Single Fee Discount Plan gives WV E-ZPass personal accounts unlimited annual travel for one fee.

entries.name: Parkersburg Bridge Partners (Memorial Bridge, MOV PASS)
entries.parent_company: Parkersburg Bridge Partners (Memorial Bridge, MOV PASS)
entries.notes: MOV PASS and E-ZPass.

entries.name: Wyoming vehicle registration renewal (county treasurers)
entries.parent_company: Wyoming Department of Transportation - Motor Vehicle Services
entries.notes: Registrations are renewed at your county treasurer (county + state fees, based on factory price and age). Several counties offer online renewal with the PIN on the renewal notice (example: Sheridan County). Contact your county treasurer. Wyoming Disabled Veteran plates: residents receiving 50%+ service-connected VA disability compensation may get distinctive DV plates for a car, pickup, motorcycle or multipurpose vehicle; one additional pair available at regular registration fees.
